t: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 5
d: This episode includes: D.B. Cooper Parts 1 & 2, Update: Math Teacher Escape, Friends to the End & Update and Babe's Uniform & Update.

t: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 6
d: This episode includes: Son of Sam Pt. 1, Mystery Cowboy, Slain Swain & Update, and Update: Badlands.

t: The Haunting Of. . .: Kelly Carlson
d: Kim Russo accompanies her on this journey and explains why Kelly has attracted these spirits.

t: The Haunting Of. . .: Regis Philbin
d: Regis and Kim explore one of the most haunted places in America.

t: The Haunting Of. . .: Chazz Palminteri
d: Kim and Chazz find out why the ghost contacted him and other messages he has to deliver.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Time Travel
d: A lawyer and from the Pacific Northwest claims to have been part of a secret government time travel experiment, known as Project Pegasus.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Rendlesham Forest UFO Incident
d: Richard travels to England to investigate Britain's Roswell, also known as the Woodbridge-Bentwaters UFO incident, considered by many to be one of the best documented UFO cases on record

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Central Banking Conspiracy
d: Richard speaks with several independent researchers about the efforts of  international bankers to control the course of history and enslave humanity through their monopoly of the creation of money and the manipulation of the money supply.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
d: Could vampires be real?  A well-known U.S. paranormal investigator and folklorist  in New York City recounts the legend and evolution of the vampire throughout history and from culture to culture.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Roswell UFO Crash
d: Richard speaks with the pre-eminent investigators of the alleged crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Death of Princess Diana - Tragic Car Accident or Murder Most Foul?
st: The Death of Princess Diana - Tragic Car Accident or Murder Most Foul?
d: An investigation into the various conspiracy theories revolving around the tragic death of Diana, The People's Princess, in Paris in August 1997.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Secret Space Program
d: Were the Mercury, Genesis, Apollo and Space Shuttle programs mere window dressing designed for public consumption?

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Werewolves
d: The legend of the werewolf throughout history and in various cultures is explored. The Conspiracy Show travels to England and rural Wisconsin to investigate claims of actual werewolf sightings.

t: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
d: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

t: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
d: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

t: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
d: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

t: My Haunted House: Vow of Silence and Cryptic
d: A single mother's new home was once a convent that kept a horrifying secret. A couple is tormented by the meaning of a date that keeps appearing in their new home.

t: My Haunted House: Family Grave and Deception
d: A man's childhood fears come to life when he returns to his family's farm after his mother's death. A woman begins to suspect that her withdrawn husband may be causing the unexplainable occurrences in their new home.

t: My Haunted House: The Attic and 'Til Death
d: A college student is tormented by her little sister's imaginary friend. A newly engaged woman sees visions of her fiance's widow.

t: My Ghost Story: The Boy in the Closet
d: A couple is haunted by the spirit of a little boy who lives in their young son's bedroom closet. A gas station owner's life is abruptly changed by the appearance of a mysterious paranormal mist with a demonic presence.

t: My Ghost Story: Screams in the Dark
d: Two men retire without knowing their new home sits on the graves of people who were tortured and murdered by the KKK. The Queen Mary once ruled the high seas, but now ghosts roam her decks.

t: My Ghost Story: The Face in the Window
d: A woman under assault by an aggressive entity is rescued by the spirit of her deceased son. A maid who was murdered in the 19th century continues to work at an old Texas hotel.

t: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Haunted Bergen House
d: With the help of ghost hunter Megan Deputy, Nick investigates the Haunted Bergen House.

t: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Fire in the Church
d: Nick tries to determine if the ghosts of priests that died in a 1948 fire are haunting the property today.
